data.description: From the Result Validator report, row 1 (AC-1, Partial). room/Cargo.toml depends on axum, tokio, serde, serde_json, getrandom, subtle, rustls, tokio-rustls, webpki-roots, futures-util and optional tokio-tungstenite; no generator, verifier or LLM crate and no path dependency on pipeline/, but nothing in just test asserts it (room/tests/boundary.rs checks unsafe and the vault only). The check is T-16's deliverable and PQ-21 waits on H-4, so this splits the static half out. Shape: a test under room/tests/ (boundary.rs or a sibling) that reads room/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock's room subgraph and fails if any crate or path matches a denylist (anthropic, openai, llm, generator, popquiz, pipeline, miri, rustc_*), plus a source scan of room/src for a use of any such module; cargo test picks it up, so the justfile is untouched. Acceptance: the test passes on main; a planted path dependency on ../pipeline in a throwaway copy fails it (name the mutation). HELD: minted from the audit; released on the client's word.
